name: Mister Fantastic

abilityDetails.Physical Resistance: Fiziksel hasarlı saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Energy Resistance: Enerji hasarlı saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Evade: Rakip saldırılarından otomatik olarak kaçmayı sağlar.
abilityDetails.Pre-Fight: Dövüş başlamadan önce Pre-Fight ekranından değiştirilebilen yetenek.
abilityDetails.Petrify: Düşmanın iyileşme ve güç kazanım hızını azaltır.
abilityDetails.Suppression: Muharebe Güç Oranını belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Cross-Fight Ability: Saldıran veya savunan şampiyona uygulanabilen ve bir görev içinde birden fazla dövüş boyunca süren yetenek.
abilityDetails.Stagger: Sendeletilen (Staggered) şampiyonlar bir sonraki kazandıkları buff'ı Nullify eder.
abilityDetails.Taunt: Saldırı gücünü %40 azaltır ve özel saldırı etkinleştirme şansını %70 artırır.
abilityDetails.Shock: Zamanla elektrik tabanlı şok hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Kendisinde veya rakipte aktif her hasarsız negatif efekt için %5 kaçış şansı kazanır. Aynı özel saldırı 2 kez kullanılırsa hasarı azalır. Purify eden veya isabetli saldırılı şampiyon kullan.
signatureAbility:
The Smartest Man In The Battlerealm
Mister Fantastic's Offensive Combat Power Rate is increased by [10 - 50]% for each Careful Study Passive on the Opponent.
Mister Fantastic gains an additional flat 20% chance to Evade any Unblockable attack. This increases by 3% every time the Opponent starts an Unblockable hit, capped at 50% for basic attacks.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: Physical and Energy Resistance increased by +[1,178.57].
5% flat chance to Evade for each non-Damaging Debuff on either Champion. Does not trigger during a Well-Timed Block.
Attack Rating is increased by +[797.84] for each Debuff on the Opponent.

abilitySections.title: Prepared for Anything - Pre-Fight Ability
content: Before the fight, choose up to 3 unique Debuffs to place on the Opponent at the start of the next fight. Each Debuff costs 1 Persistent Charge.
Mister Fantastic starts with 4 Persistent Charge(s), and can have up to 9. When Mr. Fantastic finishes a fight, he gains 1 Persistent Charge for each unique Debuff on the Opponent.
These Debuffs each last 15 second(s), and are refreshed when the Opponent is knocked down.
The Debuffs are applied even if a different Champion enters the fight.
Debuff potency scales with the rarity of Mr. Fantastic. If different versions of a Debuff are applied, only the strongest one triggers.

abilitySections.title: Prepared for Anything - Pre-Fight Debuffs - Max: 3 Each
content: Inflict a Petrify of 35% Potency.
Suppress the Opponent, decreasing their Combat Power Rate by 22%.

Debuff Siphon the Opponent, increasing the potency of Damage over Time Debuffs on them by 22%, and reducing the potency of those effects on allies by the same amount. This does not affect abilities that trigger at the start of the fight.

abilitySections.title: Opponent activates a Special Attack
content: When the Opponent activates a Special Attack, place an indefinite Careful Study Debuff on them for that Special Attack.
A Careful Study Debuff lowers the Attack Rating of each Hit in the Special Attack by 25%.
If Mister Fantastic was struck by the last hit of the Special Attack, place 1 additional copy of the Debuff.
All copies of the Debuff are Purified when the Opponent activates a different Special Attack than the one that triggered the Debuff.

abilitySections.title: Careful Study - Cross-Fight Ability
content: When the Opponent has 3 copies of a Careful Study Debuff, they are combined into a Passive that lasts for the rest of the fight, and the next 5 fights the Opponent participates in.
Careful Study Passives count as 3 Debuffs for Reed's other abilities.
Each Passive prevents future matching Careful Study Debuffs.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: On the last hit, pause Pre-Fight Debuffs for 3 second(s).

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks
content: If no Pre-Fight Debuffs were selected, Special Attacks are Unblockable.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: When this Attack is activated, 100% chance to place a Stagger Debuff and a Taunt Debuff that lowers Attack Rating by 0.4%. Each lasts for 9 second(s).
This Taunt is removed when the Opponent activates any Special Attack.
The next time a Staggered Opponent triggers a Buff, that Buff and all other Buffs triggered at the same time will be immediately Nullified.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: When this Attack is activated, re-trigger Mister Fantastic's selected Pre-Fight Debuffs once each.
The last hit Shocks the Opponent, dealing [5,983.8] Energy Damage over 5 second(s).

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: If the Opponent has at least 1 Debuff, gain a Passive Fury for 20 second(s), increasing Attack Rating by [2,991.9] for each Debuff on the Opponent.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - The Smartest Man In The Battlerealm
content: Mister Fantastic's Offensive Combat Power Rate is increased by [10 - 50]% for each Careful Study Passive on the Opponent.
Mister Fantastic gains an additional flat 20% chance to Evade any Unblockable attack. This increases by 3% every time the Opponent starts an Unblockable hit, capped at 50% for basic attacks.
